name: io.github.ensamblaTec/neoanvil
title: NeoAnvil
description: MCP server & SRE orchestrator for AI-assisted coding. Pure-Go multi-workspace dispatcher with Code Property Graph, HNSW vector search, lifecycle hooks (BRIEFING → BLAST_RADIUS → Edit → certify), and a transactional code-mutation pipeline that AST-validates and shadow-compiles every change before a time-limited certification seal.

highlights: 23 radar intents (BRIEFING, BLAST_RADIUS, SEMANTIC_CODE, AST_AUDIT, GRAPH_WALK, etc.)
Code Property Graph with SSA-based call graph + PageRank
HNSW vector index with binary quantization
Plugin subsystem: Jira Cloud, DeepSeek, GitHub
